note: EVERY threshold in this file is PROVISIONAL. Nothing here has been validated against ground truth.

timezone.note: collection_time is treated as local Maldives time for every departure/arrival. No shift is applied. Organisers have not confirmed the clock.

speed.speed_unit_note: consistent with knots (derived km/h / raw speed is about 1.9, 1 knot = 1.852 km/h), pending organiser confirmation

jetty.note: Once data/manual/harbours/jetty_verification.csv is present, only rows it marks VERIFIED or CORRECTED are used; unlisted rows are skipped (verification_status:blank). The overlay was checked against live OpenStreetMap on 2026-10-24. Without the file the fallback applies: numeric OSM id and high confidence. 'Bus stop' rows tagged ferry_terminal in OSM are skipped by name.

full.note: Whole study area (AA, ADh, K, V, Greater Malé): inhabited islands plus any island with a qualifying terminal-class jetty.

stop_location_mode_options.island_shoreline: a stop is at the island: a run inside a band of radius_m either side of the island's OneMap shoreline. Harbour reference, jetty points and jetty verification are not read.
stop_location_mode_options.jetty: a stop is within radius_m of a verified jetty point (shoreline band only for islands without one, flagged no_jetty_point). Kept for later; outputs may then carry jetty ids.

stops.note: PROVISIONAL. radius_m is the shoreline band width (m) in island_shoreline mode (the default). A stop is a run of consecutive observations of one trajectory inside that band (or, in jetty mode, within radius_m of a verified jetty) lasting at least dwell_seconds. A gap longer than stop_gap_flag_seconds inside a run marks the stop unconfirmed; nothing is filled or interpolated. Runs never cross a trajectory split or a non-accepted transition.

classification.note: PROVISIONAL, taken from FollowMe_pipeline/boat_filter.py and boat_types.py (speedboat p90 >= 18 kn, slow < 14 kn, 14-18 reported as mixed). Speed is derived from accepted movement segments (km/h / kmh_per_knot), not the raw field. A path of >= 2 km of consecutive accepted moving segments replaces the original 2 km straight-line sea run. Land share is estimated on a deterministic sample of observations per device. Classes are review hints and never filter rows.

services.note: PROVISIONAL. Departures at the first stop are clustered within departure_window_minutes; a cluster seen on >= min_days_regular distinct days is a regular service. A shorter signature matches a longer canonical route when it keeps the same order and omits at most max_skipped_stops stops.

coverage.note: PROVISIONAL. A date has good coverage when regional active devices >= min_day_device_ratio x the monthly median and at least min_site_devices distinct devices were seen near the signature's stops. Otherwise 'not observed' says little.

disclosure.note: No exported row may be backed by fewer than both minima. Per-date device counts below the device minimum are shown as '<3'.

mtcc_compare.note: PROVISIONAL. A gap between consecutive published MTCC departures on one island pair at least this long is a 'long wait'; inferred services whose median departure falls inside it are flagged as possible alternatives.

use_unconfirmed_stops_note: PROVISIONAL. true: a stop with a ping gap > stops.stop_gap_flag_seconds is flagged unconfirmed (never filled) but its last in-zone observation is still used as the departure time; every export carries unconfirmed_origin_share. false (strict) removes those journeys from regular-service detection; the strict result is reported under sensitivity in service_summary.json (it removes most services at the 300 s gap threshold because sampling gaps are often longer than 5 minutes).
